# AppsFlyer OneLink
> AppsFlyer’s deep linking platform helps mobile marketers create seamless app experiences and measure campaign attribution accurately.

OneLink is part of AppsFlyer’s Deep Linking Suite, focused on connecting users from web, QR, email, text, and other touchpoints into the right in-app destination while preserving attribution and customer experience.

## Deep Linking Suite
- [Deep Linking Suite](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/): Overview of AppsFlyer’s deep linking products for app engagement and attribution.
- [Web-to-App](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/web-to-app/): Drive users from mobile web experiences directly into the app.
- [QR-to-App](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/qr-to-app/): Connect offline and physical touchpoints to app installs and opens.
- [Email-to-App](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/email-to-app/): Send users from email campaigns into relevant in-app destinations.
- [Text-to-App](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/text-to-app/): Route SMS and messaging traffic into the app with attribution.

## Measurement Suite
- [Measurement Suite](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/): Overview of AppsFlyer’s measurement and attribution capabilities across channels.
- [Mobile Attribution](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/mobile-attribution/): Measure mobile app installs, re-engagement, and campaign performance.
- [CTV Attribution](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/ctv-attribution/): Attribute connected TV campaigns to downstream app activity.
- [PC & Console Attribution](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/pc-console-attribution/): Measure acquisition and engagement across PC and console environments.
- [Cross-Platform Measurement](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/cross-platform-measurement/): Unify attribution across devices, channels, and operating systems.
- [ROI Measurement](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/roi-measurement/): Evaluate campaign return on investment with performance measurement.
- [Marketing Analytics](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/marketing-analytics/): Analyze campaign and channel performance with marketing analytics tools.

## Optimization & Protection
- [Incrementality](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/incrementality/): Measure the true lift generated by marketing activity.
- [Creative Optimization](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/creative-optimization/): Assess and improve creative performance across campaigns.
- [Audience Segmentation](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/audience-segmentation/): Build and activate audience segments for better targeting.
- [Fraud Protection](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/fraud-protection/): Detect and prevent ad fraud affecting app marketing performance.
- [Product Analytics](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/product-analytics/): Understand in-app behavior and product usage after acquisition.

## Key Product Areas
- [Deep Linking Suite](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/): Central product area for OneLink-powered deep linking journeys.
- [Measurement Suite](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/): Core measurement platform supporting attribution and analytics.
- [Product Analytics](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/product-analytics/): Product analytics for retention, engagement, and user behavior insights.
- [Web-to-App](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/web-to-app/): Specialized deep linking flow from websites into mobile apps.
- [QR-to-App](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/qr-to-app/): Deep linking support for QR-based acquisition and engagement.
- [Email-to-App](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/email-to-app/): Deep linking support for lifecycle and CRM email campaigns.
- [Text-to-App](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/deep-linking/text-to-app/): Deep linking support for SMS and messaging-based engagement.

## Attribution Use Cases
- [Mobile Attribution](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/mobile-attribution/): Standard attribution for mobile app install and re-engagement campaigns.
- [CTV Attribution](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/ctv-attribution/): Attribution workflows for connected TV advertising campaigns.
- [PC & Console Attribution](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/pc-console-attribution/): Attribution support for gaming and non-mobile platforms.
- [Cross-Platform Measurement](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/cross-platform-measurement/): Measurement across multiple user devices and media channels.
- [ROI Measurement](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/roi-measurement/): ROI-focused reporting for campaign and channel evaluation.

## Analytics & Growth
- [Marketing Analytics](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/marketing-analytics/): Reporting and analysis for campaign performance and spend efficiency.
- [Incrementality](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/incrementality/): Quantify incremental impact beyond baseline conversions.
- [Creative Optimization](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/creative-optimization/): Improve ad creative effectiveness using performance data.
- [Audience Segmentation](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/measurement/audience-segmentation/): Create actionable user segments for activation and analysis.
- [Product Analytics](https://www.appsflyer.com/products/product-analytics/): Analyze post-install behavior to support growth decisions.
